title: Tabdeeli Mushkil Hai
body:
Tabdeeli mushkill hai tu kaise layega
Tabdeeli ayegi jab mehdi aayega
Ye parcham ghazi ka ghar ghar lehrayega
Tabdeeli aayegi jab mehdi aayega
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Jashn ki vo rath ho , Khushio ki barath ho
Aaye mera barwa , Ghazi maula sath ho
Qayam ka insaf ho , Qayam ki talwar ho
Aur bibi ke samne ,Dushmano pe war ho
Qatil bibi ka jab pakda jayega
Tabdeeli aayegi jab mehdi aayega
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Dil se ye izhar kar , Man se ye iqrar kar
Phir tabdeeli ayegi ,Tu chauda se pyar kar
Majlis bhi azad ho ,Aur maula se pyar ho
Tere har makaan me ,Matam zindabad ho
Allah taala se tu rutbe payega
Tabdeeli aayegi Jab mehdi aayega
( New Misre Added by Akber Naqvi & group)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Haan aale saud ko, Aur unki aulad ko
Jisne bhi mismar kiya , Zehra ki mazar ko
Qayam ka ZAHOOR ho ,Aur na inki khair ho
Har bibi ke mujrim par Mehdi ki talwar ho
Rouza dadi ka vo khud banwaega
Tabdeeli aayegi Jab mehdi aayega
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Jab Aayega Barwaan ,Hum sabke jo darmiya'n
Rukjayegi teeragi ,Khiljayega aasma'n
Ghazi bhi jab sath ho ,Dar ho phir kis bath ka
Dekhkar maula ghazi ko,bhagega jab har haiwa'n
Lanat teeno par khul kar padwaega
Tabdeeli aayegi Jab mehdi aayega
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Ye manzar dunia ko dikhlaya jayega
har ghasib ka tala khulwaya jayega
Jab qayam ke aage sab laya jayega
Tab fidak ke choro ko latkaya jayega
Har dushman matam ka dozaq me jayega
Tabdeeli aayegi Jab mehdi aayega
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Shimr ho Yazeed ho ,Quli Ho Marwaan Ho
Ho Sinan Ibne Anas ,Ya Koi Bhi Haiwan Ho
Mushrik Ho Ya Munkir Ho ,Ghali ho Nusairi Ho
Khooni matam se Jalne ,Wala Koi Insan Ho
In sab ki Gardan Par ,Khanjar Chal jaye ga
Tabdeeli aayegi Jab mehdi aayega
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Baarve maula ke saath, ghazi maula aayenge
Sari dunia me hukumat , shaan...se chalayenge
Ek Hi Mazhab Hoga , Ek Hi Mimbar Hoga
Ghazi Ka Parcham Hoga, har shia haq par hoga
Haider ka dushman...tab chup na payega
Tabdeeli aayegi Jab mehdi aayega
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Dushmane Aale Aba se, Hum Lade Or maat de
Bhounke jo shabbir par , aisi zaban ko kaatde
Kasrate Matam Rahe Aur, hum Namaze bhi pade
Har ibadath me zahoore qayam ki dua kare
Ye qissa har din ka jad se mitjayega
Tabdeeli aayegi jab mehdi aayega
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Jo Liya Vaada Use , Muqtar Ne Poora Kiya
Qatilane Sarwar Ko, Waasile Dozaq Kiya
Aayega Jab Baarwa'n Leke Apni Zulfeqar
Un Sab Makkaro Ko dozaq se Bulwayega
Manzar Vo AKBER dohrayajeyga
Tabdeeli aayegi jab mehdi Aayega
